evals.prompt: Add a new herb selection modal to the prescription form. It should have a search bar, a paginated herb list, and a confirm button that returns the selected herbs to the parent form.
evals.expected_output: After MyWorkFlow loads this supplement: IMPLEMENT phase invokes frontend-design for the new modal component and ui-ux-pro-max for modal layout/styling decisions. Runs npx tsc --noEmit before each commit.

evals.prompt: The prescription table columns keep resizing when I select different herbs. The column widths aren't fixed and the whole page layout shifts.
evals.expected_output: During REVIEW phase, catches the layout stability violation — Table columns must have explicit widths, Select/Input must use fixed widths. Flags as a frontend rule violation (frontend.md: 禁止页面宽高抖动).
